README: Which sentences of which long recording make which clip of narration.md. Run: python3 scripts/split-takes.py the-barber-who-never-went-to-parties, then scripts/narration.py build. All takes are voice-03. The narrator and the barber are one person, so one voice. The two friends are the same voice moved up and down (pitch and size together): the voices picked for them (voice-07, voice-06) were not available in the session that recorded this.

clips.text: One year earlier, I could not cut paper.
In this town, every night was a party. And every night, my friends knocked on my door.
I had seen a barber on TV make a grown man cry with one haircut. Happy tears. I wanted to do that.
It was not fixable. Dad wore a hat until spring.
While my friends were out dancing, I was cutting.
I went through hundreds of mops, thousands of combs, and one very patient dog.
Spring came. And Dad sat back down in the chair.
Then the busiest barbershop in town put a sign in the window.
It was a Saturday. The line went around the block. One man had grown a beard waiting.
I cut forty heads before lunch.
I still have not been to a party.
Dude! It's Friday! The whole town is over there!
Help! The party starts in an hour, and look at him!
Wait. It's the weird one!
You coming?!
Bro. How?!
Who stays home on a Friday?! You're being weird again!
Please! Is this fixable?!
Okay! Okay! That's fixable!
That's fixable!
Training.
